_about: Every tunable number in SkillUp. tools/simulate.py reads this with data/game_data.json and reports how long things take. Change numbers here, re-run, compare.

xp._about: Skill point L -> L+1 costs base * (1 + L / per_level) XP. Colors multiply XP per action.
xp._game_speed: Tuned for a realistic player (tools/simulate.py PLAYERS), not a perfect one: Long ~20 h, Normal ~10 h, Sync ~4 h (a sync game played in one sitting)

thunderfury._about: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker: an optional legendary sword, crafted with Blacksmithing at 300 once you have Molten Core (listed with the Fire Resistance set). Legendary tier, and its lightning counts as the right weapon against every creature trait. Not a check.
thunderfury.name: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker

trinket._about: Darkmoon Card, a hidden legendary trinket. Each skill point gained has find_chance to find it (once per game). Once worn, each skill point gained has bonus_chance to give one more, never past the rank's cap.
trinket.name: Darkmoon Card

actions._about: Base time (s) and XP of the k-th thing (slot 0-3) of rank r: time * rank_growth^r * (1 + slot_growth * k). XP per action = time * xp_per_second, so every action pays the same XP per second before upgrades; upgrades make it faster.
actions._craft_xp_mult: crafting earns more XP per second: one Workshop slot levels 6 professions while the Field levels 5
actions._gather_yield: materials per gather action: a random amount from min to max, like a WoW node or cast

recipes._about: Units of each reagent per craft, by role. XP multiplier by role (Sword = 1).

storage._about: Cap per material. Each first-crafted Tailoring bag doubles it. Overflow sells.
storage._start_by_speed: Sync starts with an extra bag's worth of room: crafting stays stocked between check-ins at that pace

gold._about: Sell value = Wowhead vendor price (copper) * sell_mult, minimum min_sell. Upgrade n of a profession costs cost_base * cost_growth^n copper.
gold._crafted_markup: a crafted item sells for the vendor value of its materials x crafted_markup (Wowhead's own craft prices jump ~7x at Expert and flooded the late game)

tools._about: An Engineering tool of rank r makes its gathering profession (r+1) * step faster.

combat._about: Weapon -> DPS (how fast you kill), armor -> HP (whether you survive). A creature of rank r, slot k needs need_dps = weapon_dps * rank_growth^r * (1 + slot_growth * k) (bosses x boss_dps_mult); fight time = its base time * clamp(need_dps / your DPS). Damage taken = creature DPS * fight time; creature DPS is set so that, with gear of its rank, a normal fight costs about `danger` of your HP. Damage taken uses the fight length from gear only: Shop speed makes fights faster in real time but doesn't reduce damage. Above death_start of your HP you start dying (fully at death_start + death_span); a death costs death_time plus the fight.
combat._trait: a weapon matching the creature's trait deals x trait_match: one rank lower beats a Sword one rank higher (1.8 x 1.1 = 1.98). No penalty otherwise; the best weapon is always picked automatically.
combat._hp: HP = base_hp + armor_hp * rank_growth^r for each of the 7 armor pieces
combat._survival: each creature deals a fixed amount per fight (danger x the HP of gear of its rank, more for later creatures and bosses); only armor decides survival, the weapon only decides speed
combat._death_time: seconds lost per death: 30 s corpse run + 3 min of Resurrection Sickness at half combat speed (about 90 s)

pool._about: Non-progression items in the pool, for the default start (220 checks - 42 progression = 178). Speed and XP Upgrades are free Shop levels for the profession that has the fewest. The simulator spreads the items evenly over a seed.

Speed Upgrade._: a free Shop Speed level for the profession with the fewest (ties: lowest skill)

XP Upgrade._: a free Shop XP level for the profession with the fewest (ties: lowest skill)

Tome of experience._: skill points' worth of XP to one profession

traps._about: Mild by design. Durations in minutes.

buffs._about: Alchemy potions and Cooking food. Used automatically when the buff is off and one is in stock; the best one first. Effect = value * (1 + rank_scale * rank). Healing Potions are drunk on a death and halve its cost. The player keeps `keep` of each kind and sells the rest.
buffs._healing_hp: HP a Healing Potion of each rank (Minor, Healing, Superior, Major) restores, about a quarter of a full armor set of its rank. Drunk only when a fight would kill you (the best one in stock): the fight is then checked again with that much more HP

red._about: Success chance when attempting something above your level, by how far below its unlock you are.
red._slow: a red attempt also takes (1 + levels below / slow_per_levels) times longer

offline._about: Progress keeps going while the page is closed, up to cap_hours. Each hour past the cap gives rested_per_hour minutes of Rested XP, pool capped at rested_cap minutes.
offline._mode: repeat = while closed, each slot only repeats what it was doing (chosen: keeps offline weaker than playing). auto = it keeps choosing the next material and recipe (tested, too strong)
offline._sells: nothing sells while the page is closed: once a material's storage is full, gathering still gives skill but extras are lost, so bags cap offline gold

ragnaros._about: Ragnaros fight: power needed and Fire Resistance needed for a good win chance.
ragnaros._formula: win chance = max_win * min(1, DPS/dps_need)^2 * min(1, HP/hp_need) * (fr_floor + (1 - fr_floor) * min(1, FR/fr_need)^2). FR = Classic FR of the set pieces worn + potion + food. A fight lasts fight_minutes; a loss also costs the death time.
ragnaros._fr_armor_rank: the Fire Resistance set is the best armor in the game (legendary): its pieces count as rank 3.5, above Artisan, and replace Artisan pieces as they are crafted
